question: Shahid Parvez Khan, Budhaditya Mukherjee, Anushka Shankar and Hara Shankar Bhattacharya are well known players of which of the following instruments?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sitar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Shahid Parvez Khan and Budhaditya Mukherjee **are renowned players of the sitar, while **Anushka Shankar,** daughter of legendary sitar maestro Ravi Shankar, also plays the sitar. **Hara Shankar Bhattacharya** is a notable player of the sarod.
 
• Ustad Shahid Parvez Khan is a maestro of the Indian classical sitar, hailing from the Imdadkhani gharana, and is renowned as the primary exponent of the seventh generation of the Etawah Gharana.
 
• Pandit Budhaditya Mukherjee is a distinguished maestro of the Indian classical sitar and surbahar, belonging to the Imdadkhani gharana. His playing style is characterized by intricate vocalic playing and spectacular high-speed performance.
 
• Anushka Hemangini Shankar is a British-American sitar player and musician, known for her virtuosity on the sitar. She is also recognized as an occasional writer and actor.
 
• Pandit Harashankar Bhattacharya is widely acclaimed as an exceptional sitarist, revered for his mastery of the instrument.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **The sitar** is a plucked stringed instrument that originated in medieval India and belongs to the lute family.
 
• It is primarily used in Hindustani classical music and typically measures around 1.2 meters in length, featuring a deep pear-shaped body, a long neck, and 20 movable frets.
 
• To produce sound, the sitar is played by striking its main strings with a plectrum known as the mizrab.
 
• Its construction, sound, and playing technique differ significantly from those of a guitar. With more strings than an acoustic guitar, the sitar produces a richer sound, although chords are not typically played on this instrument.
